stage: M1 authenticated HTTP and persistence; no combat loop
workload: 30 authenticated learners creating attempts, answering reviews, reading content/practice, and downloading a private 128 KiB asset; one instructor enqueues/reads durable jobs

rust_server.note: Measured separately from PostgreSQL and any AI/model process.

postgresql.note: Sum of postmaster and backend RSS; shared_buffers are mapped by each process and are therefore counted more than once. This is a conservative separate figure, not unique physical memory.

not_a_claim: This is not a 15-duel or 90-second combat benchmark; M1 has no combat, matchmaking, Redis, or AI worker contention.
Sessions were seeded directly in PostgreSQL to avoid the authentication rate-limit path; auth itself is covered by the M1 acceptance suite.
Latency includes local PostgreSQL, request logging, and localhost HTTP; it is not a WAN or device measurement.
